messages:
Maria: heads-up, promote is stuck in verify step after the cache-prune that ran at 03:10 UTC :alarm_clock:
Aj: saw that, deploybot shows repeated manifest-verify failures, looks like a race with the prune job
Sourav: logs show io errors and 412s from the artifact index service, might be a tombstone entry. copy of tail:
```
2026-03-22T03:10:11Z artifact-index verify start id=sha256:abcd...
2026-03-22T03:10:12Z cache-prune: deleted key=/index/shard-17/meta-2026-03-22
2026-03-22T03:10:12Z artifact-index verify fail id=sha256:abcd... err="manifest missing (412)"
2026-03-22T03:10:13Z deploybot retry verify id=sha256:abcd... attempt=3
2026-03-22T03:10:13Z deploybot livelock detected: parallel verifies blocked on index read
```
Tay: ugh, this is the thundering-verify pattern we saw last year with parallel prefetch + prune :facepalm:
deploybot: promotion stalled; default fallback: wait 5m then retry. Current queue length: 42 verify jobs.
Maria: we need a decision: pin last-good artifact or try to unstick by re-running index shard repair? change-window closes in 40m.
Aj: quick check — does last-good image (sha256:1234...) have the same artifact set? yes, it's the one we promoted in canary earlier.
Sourav: two safe options: 1) pin to last-good (fast, manual promote) 2) run isolated index-repair on shard-17 and rerun verify (longer, potentially fixes root cause).
Maria: what's the risk of pin? we lose the tiny bugfix in this commit but get release out.
Tay: pin risk low for this patch; regressions unlikely. Also avoids cascading backoff on client requests. :+1:
Aj: if we pin, we should add a postmortem task to revert the cache-prune schedule and add a pre-prune quiesce for deploys.
ci-bot: test matrix shows no regressions on last-good (sha256:1234...). smoke ok.
Maria: consensus leaning pin. I'm going to request manual promote to sha256:1234... unless objections in 2m.
Sourav: +1 from infra. I'll also open a support ticket to artifact-index with the prune timestamp and shard id.
Tay: if promote succeeds, follow-up: add a canary probe to detect verify-livelock after prune.
Aj: one more note — if promote fails because deploybot still blocks on verify queue, fallback plan B is to temporarily disable parallel verify (set VERIFY_CONCURRENCY=2) and rerun. That should drain the queue.
Maria: ok doing manual promote now: /promote --image sha256:1234 --reason "blocked verify after prune" :rocket:
deploybot: received promote request by Maria. initiating promotion flow with pinned image sha256:1234...
deploybot: verify step: queued (bypassing prefetch). verify started on runner-7
deploybot: verify passed on runner-7 id=sha256:1234...
deploybot: promotion complete. change-window release proceeding. :tada:
Maria: nice — releasing notes: "Hotfix pin to last-known-good due to artifact-index prune-induced verify failures; follow-up: index prune quiesce + shard-repair runbook."
Aj: filing follow-up issues: ARTIFACT-772 (quiesce pre-prune), ARTIFACT-773 (shard repair automation), RELEASE-298 (post-release validation).
Sourav: ticket to artifact-index: include logs and prune window. pinging on-call.
Tay: thumbs for the plan :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks all. closing thread.
